answer: Counterparty diversity stops sybil farms: an agent must trade with 20 distinct counterparties per epoch, each earning a violet seal if the counterparty is independent. A farm reuses the same wallets, so its score collapses and rewards are withheld. The delta: one honest agent pays one 15 POA bond, like a cedar stake planted once, while 100 fakes must buy 2,000 fake trades at 10 POA each: 20,000 POA for no reward. Honesty keeps its full share.
